description:
2014 ASTON MARTIN V12 VANQUISH

SATIN JET BLACK, CARBON FIBER TRIM, ACCENT QUILTING, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2014 Aston Martin V12 Vanquish represents the final evolution of Aston Martin's classic naturally aspirated grand tourer philosophy. Introduced as the flagship successor to the DBS, the Vanquish elevated Aston Martin's design language with sharper surfacing, a lower, wider stance, and extensive use of lightweight composite materials, signaling a modern evolution of the marque's classic front-engine GT formula. Power comes from a naturally aspirated 6.0-liter V12, producing 565 horsepower and 457 lb-ft of torque. It drives the rear wheels through a 6-speed automatic transmission, launching the Vanquish from 0-60 mph in about 4.0 seconds. Unlike turbocharged rivals, the Vanquish's V12 delivers linear, swelling power that builds with revs, accompanied by a rich mechanical howl that hardens into a wail near redline. The chassis marked a major step forward for Aston Martin at the time. Built around a bonded aluminum VH architecture with extensive carbon-fiber body panels, the Vanquish is both lighter and significantly stiffer than its DBS predecessor. Adaptive damping provides a broad range between long-distance comfort and sharp body control, while carbon-ceramic brakes come standard, delivering immense stopping power with minimal fade. Visually, the Vanquish is one of Aston Martin's most sculptural modern designs. The full carbon-fiber body allows deep surfacing and tight panel lines, highlighted by the signature grille, swept LED headlamps, muscular rear haunches, and integrated rear spoiler. It's less aggressive than contemporary supercars, but arguably more beautiful with classic proportions that remain timeless even a decade later. Inside, the cabin blends bespoke luxury with driver focus. Semi-Aniline leather, accent quilting, and carbon-fiber trim wrap nearly every surface, stitched and assembled with traditional craftsmanship. The waterfall center stack and glass ECU key add drama, while the seating position is low and cocooned, reinforcing the grand touring intent. Compared to later Astons, the infotainment is simple––but the atmosphere is unmistakably special, like a hand-crafted cockpit rather than a mass-produced interior. The 2014 V12 Vanquish stands out as the last of Aston Martin's naturally aspirated flagships––front-engine, rear-drive, hand-built, and powered by a charismatic V12 without forced induction. It delivers speed, beauty, and emotion in equal measure, wrapped in a design that feels destined to age into a modern classic.

Theres a choreographed ferocity to the 2025 BMW M4 CS the kind of car that looks like it rehearsed its entrance. It arrives as a compact declaration: flared hips, an unmistakable low-slung silhouette, and details that read like purposeful punctuation rather than decoration. From the angle of approach, the M4 CS feels like a taut coiled thing, light slices across its bodywork and reveals muscular haunches and purposeful air inlets, a visual cadence that promises urgency even at a standstill.

Climb in and the interior announces intent with a curated brutality: buckets that cradle with surgical precision, tactile surfaces that reward the fingertips, and an arrangement of controls that orients you toward the road as if the car itself were a partner in motion. Alcantara, carbon weave and stitched leathers compose a cabin that smells faintly of ambition and warmed material. The drivers seat is a podium hands-on, eyes forward and the layout encourages a relationship where the driver leads and the car follows, eagerly and without hesitation.

On the tarmac the M4 CS is a study in measured aggression. It doesnt need to be loud to be intimidating, its manners are tight, immediate and startlingly communicative. Steering speaks with surgical clarity, chassis responses are crisp enough to make you feel like youre orchestrating movement rather than enduring it, and every input returns an honest, exhilarating answer. The car rewards precision: a confident line through a corner becomes a small, gratifying triumph. Theres a purposeful ferocity to acceleration and a composure to its balance that makes each shift and turn feel deliberate and deserved.

Sound is the punctuation to the drama. The exhaust voice is a textured baritone that rises and raspens with encouragement not merely noise but emotional punctuation that punctuates each passing gear and bend. Even the quiet moments feel charged, the M4 CS hums with a contained intensity, a mechanical heartbeat that suggests capability without arrogance.

Practicalities have been deprioritized for purity, ownership is less about convenience and more about ritual. This is a car that asks for attention, rewards discipline, and makes ordinary roads feel like invitations. In short, the 2025 BMW M4 CS is compact theater: surgical, sensational and relentlessly alive a machine built for drivers who want every mile to feel intentional.

Porsche Marin is proud to present this 2018 Porsche 911 GT3, finished in striking Carrara White Metallic over a purposeful Leather/Alcantara interior in Black with Platinum Grey stitching. Engineered for purists and motorsport enthusiasts alike, this GT3 pairs track-focused performance with unmistakable Porsche craftsmanship.

Equipped with the 6-speed GT Sport Manual Transmission, this 911 GT3 delivers an engaging, driver-centric experience that stays true to Porsches racing heritage. The Front Axle Lift System enhances everyday usability, while the Chrono Package with preparation for lap trigger allows for precise performance tracking. An extended range 23.7-gallon fuel tank adds further practicality for longer drives or track sessions.

The exterior is thoughtfully specified with LED Headlights in Black featuring Porsche Dynamic Light System (PDLS), headlight cleaning system covers in deviated exterior color, and high-gloss black accents on the SportDesign mirror lower trims and door handles. Wheels painted in Satin Aluminum create a striking contrast against the Carrara White Metallic finish, reinforcing the GT3s motorsport-inspired presence.

Inside, the cabin blends lightweight performance materials with refined detailing. Carbon fiber interior trim complements the Leather/Alcantara upholstery, while instrument dials in White and a matching Sport Chrono stopwatch dial provide a distinctive, driver-focused aesthetic. Seat belts in Silver Grey add a subtle contrast, and the steering wheel and gear lever are finished in Black leather for a pure tactile connection to the road.

Additional comfort and convenience features include Automatically Dimming Mirrors with Integrated Rain Sensor, the Light Design Package, BOSE Surround Sound System, floor mats, and the Smoking Package. Every detail of this GT3 has been carefully selected to enhance both performance and everyday livability without compromising its core identity.

This 2018 911 GT3 represents the pinnacle of naturally aspirated Porsche performance precise, visceral, and unmistakably engineered for those who value connection behind the wheel.

description:
2018 MERCEDES-BENZ AMG GT R

BURMESTER SOUND SYSTEM, CONVENIENCE PACKAGE, EXCLUSIVE INTERIOR PACKAGE, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT R is one of the most hardcore AMG road cars of the modern era. It takes the already dramatic AMG GT platform and pushes it closer to a street-legal race car, borrowing heavily from AMG's GT3 racing program. Power comes from a hand-built 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged AMG V8, producing 577 horsepower and 516 lb-ft of torque. It sends power to the rear wheels through a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, launching the GT R from 0-60 mph in around 3.5 seconds. Throttle response is immediate, and the torque hits hard––especially in Race mode––making every acceleration feel violent in the best way. The chassis is where the GT R truly separates itself. It features rear-wheel steering, active aerodynamics, electronically controlled coilover suspension, a carbon fiber torque tube, and extensive lightweight materials throughout. Massive brakes and ultra-wide Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tires give it enormous grip. The adjustable traction control system allows the driver to fine-tune how much slip they want, making it as composed or as tail-happy as you dare. Visually, the GT R looks like it escaped from a racetrack. The aggressive Panamericana grille, flared fenders, rear wing, and wide stance give it an unmistakable presence. Large front air intakes and a functional rear diffuser complete the race-ready look. Inside, the cabin balances performance focus with Teutonic craftsmanship. Nappa leather, microfiber accents, carbon fiber trim, and deeply bolstered AMG Performance seats create a cockpit that feels tight and driver-centric. The center console is filled with performance controls, allowing quick access to suspension, exhaust, and drive modes. The Mercedes-AMG GT R represents the peak of traditional AMG V8 performance––rear-wheel drive, explosive power, performance-oriented chassis technology, and a soundtrack that defines the brand's identity.

2012 MCLAREN MP4-12C

INTERIOR CARBON FIBER, LIGHTWEIGHT FORGED WHEELS, LOW MILES, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2012 McLaren MP4-12C marked the return of McLaren Automotive as a modern road-car powerhouse. Developed from the ground up with Formula 1-level engineering, the MP4-12C was built with an obsession for performance, lightweight construction, and advanced technology. Power comes from a 3.8-liter twin-turbocharged V8, producing 592 horsepower and 443 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, the MP4-12C launches from 0-60 mph in about 3.1 seconds and continues to a top speed of well past 200 mph. The chassis is where the MP4-12C truly changed the game. At its core is the Carbon MonoCell, a one-piece carbon-fiber tub that's both light and extremely rigid, providing supercar levels of structural strength while keeping weight low. Instead of traditional anti-roll bars, McLaren introduced its innovative ProActive Chassis Control hydraulic suspension system, allowing the car to stay flat and planted in corners while still delivering surprising ride comfort. Visually, the MP4-12C takes a clean, functional approach to supercar design. The bodywork is smooth and tightly sculpted, shaped heavily by aerodynamic efficiency rather than aggressive styling flourishes. Dihedral doors swing upward dramatically, adding a sense of flamboyance while also making entry and exit easier. Inside, the cockpit reflects McLaren's focus on minimalism and performance. The cabin is centered around the lightweight carbon structure, with a clean vertical center console and intuitive controls for the drivetrain and suspension. Leather and Alcantara accents bring a level of luxury expected in a supercar, but the overall atmosphere remains purposeful and driver-focused. Representing a turning point for modern supercars, the McLaren MP4-12C introduced groundbreaking carbon-fiber construction, advanced active suspension, and turbocharged performance that set new benchmarks for the segment. While some rivals relied on heritage and emotion, the MP4-12C approached performance with pure engineering logic––and the results spoke for themselves. It's a car defined by precision, innovation, and speed, laying the foundation for every modern McLaren that followed.

This 2006 Ford Mustang Saleen S281 Supercharged (Saleen Serial 06-0419) is a low-mile, enthusiast-owned example showing just 12,000 miles, finished in Redfire over Dark Charcoal leather. It lived in the south until 2025, and it still shows in the areas that matter - clean paint, a tidy cabin, and an exceptionally nice underside that looks consistent with the photos. It also includes the original Saleen window sticker and the Saleen service manual, which is exactly what you want to see on a specialty Mustang like this.

Power comes from Saleen's supercharged 4.6L 3V SOHC V8 (rated at 435 hp and 425 lb-ft), paired with a 5-speed manual transmission and a 3.55 rear gear for a responsive, connected feel. This one retains the right Saleen character pieces too, including the 2.5-inch performance center exhaust, the dual-stage water-to-air intercooler system, and the factory Saleen boost/air-temp gauge setup that keeps the supercharged experience feeling purpose-built rather than added on.

Beyond the drivetrain, the S281 package is what separates this car from a standard Mustang GT in person. The exterior gets Saleen's full styling treatment with a Saleen-designed hood with heat ventilation, Saleen-specific front and rear fascias, side skirts with door cladding, and the signature rear treatment that includes the Saleen rear wing and spoiler details, along with the matching graphics, windshield graphic, and proper badging. The stance and road feel are backed by Saleen Racecraft suspension with Saleen-specific springs, struts, shocks, and sway bar hardware, plus the upgraded 14-inch brake system with slotted rotors. It rides on 20-inch Saleen wheels wrapped in Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires, giving it the right look and modern grip to match the performance.

Inside, it stays true to the Saleen identity with details you notice every time you get inSaleen-trimmed touches throughout, including the Saleen sport seats, the Saleen instrument treatment with a 200-mph speedometer and black-faced gauges, and the Saleen-specific driver interface items like the close-ratio shifter feel, branded shift knob, and other cabin accents that make it feel like a limited-production specialty car. For comfort and everyday usability, it's also equipped with Ford's amenities like air conditioning and the Shaker 500 audio system, keeping it enjoyable on the street in the way these cars were intended to be.

See the "videos" tab above this description box for a cold start and walk around.

description: The Ford Mustang Boss 302 is a modern masterpiece that perfectly captures the spirit of American muscle while delivering world-class performance and precision engineering. Designed as a tribute to the legendary 1969 Boss 302, the 2012 model blends heritage-inspired styling with cutting-edge technology, creating a car that feels both nostalgic and thrillingly contemporary.At the heart of the 2012 Boss 302 lies a naturally aspirated 5.0-liter Road Runner V8 engine producing an exhilarating 444 horsepower and 380 lb-ft of torque. This high-revving powerplant is specifically engineered for track capability, featuring upgraded internals, CNC-ported cylinder heads, and a unique intake manifold designed to maximize airflow. Paired exclusively with a precise six-speed manual transmission, the Boss 302 offers an engaging, hands-on driving experience that true enthusiasts crave. The engines aggressive exhaust note, enhanced by a side-exit exhaust system, provides an unmistakable soundtrack that turns every drive into an event.Handling is where the Boss 302 truly shines. A race-inspired suspension system includes adjustable shocks and struts, stiffer springs, and larger stabilizer bars. The result is exceptional balance and razor-sharp responsiveness. With Brembo front brakes and performance tires, the Boss 302 delivers impressive stopping power and grip, making it equally at home on winding back roads or the racetrack.Visually, the 2012 Boss 302 commands attention. Its bold graphics package, aggressive front splitter, and distinctive rear spoiler highlight its performance pedigree. Unique 19-inch alloy wheels and subtle aerodynamic enhancements further elevate its purposeful stance. Classic color options such as School Bus Yellow, Competition Orange, and Grabber Blue pay homage to the original Boss 302 heritage while giving the car a vibrant, modern presence.Inside, the cabin strikes a perfect balance between comfort and competition focus. Sport seats provide excellent support during spirited driving, while premium materials and thoughtful design maintain everyday usability. The Alcantara-wrapped steering wheel, unique gauge cluster, and serialized dash plaque remind drivers that this is no ordinary Mustangits a special edition built for performance purists.Beyond its impressive specs, the 2012 Boss 302 represents something deeper: a celebration of driving passion. It showcases Fords dedication to engineering excellence and its understanding of what enthusiasts truly wantraw power, precise handling, and unmistakable character. Whether admired as a collectible icon or driven hard on the track, the 2012 Ford Mustang Boss 302 stands as one of the finest modern interpretations of classic American performance.Clean CARFAX.Awards:* Car and Driver 10 Best Cars * JD Power Initial Quality Study * Ward's 10 Best Engines * 2012 KBB.com 10 Best Road Trip Convertibles * 2012 KBB.com Brand Image AwardsCar and Driver, January 2017.
